summary: Finish finite animations after kit story plays, before accessibility checks, and report the post-DOM readiness phases without weakening strict lifecycle or isolation controls.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: All indexed stories and four viewport/theme cases remain required. Fresh page realms and cleared storage are retained. A bounded stable drain finishes finite animations and onfinish chains after play; errors or instability by accessibility afterEach fail the strict proof. Infinite animations and strict storyFinished checks remain unchanged. Natural/accelerated WAAPI, CSS transition, no-fill/backwards-fill keyframes and animation-chain controls must pass axe at matching endpoints; a paused low-contrast control must fail specifically through axe color-contrast. Isolation controls cover reduced motion and persisted theme globals.
